name: User Registration Reminder
description: Sends reminder emails to users who registered but haven't completed a step (e.g. verifying/first login).
project_description:
The User Registration Reminder module for Drupal is designed to send reminder emails to users who have registered but have never logged in.

 The module also allows site administrators to configure the interval for sending reminders, as well as customize the email subject and body and the action to take after the final reminder.

 
Features 
 
 Schedule reminder emails 
 Configure email subject and body for reminder emails 
 Automatically send reminder emails using Drupal Cron 
 Configure final action for users that never logged in despite the reminders 
 
 Back to top 

 
Requirements 
 This module requires no modules outside of Drupal core.

 Back to top 

 
Installation 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. For further information, see Installing Drupal Modules .

 Back to top 

 
Configuration 
 After the installation, go to Administration » Configuration » People »User Registration Reminder Settings in order to enable the module's functionality and configure any settings.
